## Verification

- [ ] I maintain this repository or have permission to represent it.
- [ ] The repository and evidence link are public.
- [ ] The evidence shows an actual Kepenk integration.
- [ ] The entry is added to the correct section of `ADOPTERS.md`.
- [ ] Founding-team work is not presented as independent adoption.
- [ ] No private code, credentials, or private operational information is included.
- [ ] Project statements are limited to what the public evidence supports.
- [ ] I agree that the project and links may appear in the public registry.
